title: Get Attribute List with two requested attributes
purpose: Exercise interaction between the CIP service path, attribute-count field, and multiple attribute identifiers within an unconnected CPF item.
expected_behavior: The receiver should parse a 32-byte encapsulation payload, decode the two CPF items, and process CIP service 0x03 with an attribute count of two and attribute identifiers 0x0001 and 0x0002, returning a normal response or service error.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation length is 32 bytes and covers the complete CPF and CIP request.
The unconnected-data item length is 12 bytes, matching the CIP service, path, count, and two 16-bit attribute identifiers.
The path-size field is two words and corresponds to Class 0x04 and Instance 0x01 logical segments.
Attribute count and identifiers are encoded as little-endian 16-bit values, following the supplied little-endian encapsulation and item conventions.
The exact CIP attribute-list request layout is treated as a conservative model inference because the supplied excerpts do not specify its complete body grammar.
issue_safety_notes: This seed explores count and field interactions with bounded values and does not copy the historical issue payload or use a path that consumes all remaining data; issue 314 is cited only as evidence for exercising valid-session SendRRData handling.
